# MRP Rule 1 - The round only ends at the Lobby screen
Unlike on low roleplay (LRP) servers, the round is [italic]only[/italic] considered over once the game has returned to the Lobby screen. This means that all roleplay rules and MRP rules are still in effect, even after the end-of-round popup.
## Examples
Acceptable: - After the end-of-round popup appears, an antagonist with an objective to steal the Chief Medical Officer's hypospray attacks the Chief Medical Officer in order to rob them. - After the end-of-round popup appears, Security continues to makes an effort to enforce Space Law and detain known criminals. - After the end-of-round popup appears, crew marooned on the station continue to defend themselves against any remaining threats.
Prohibited: - After the end-of-round popup appears, an antagonist kills the Chief Medical Officer despite having no objectives related to doing so. - After the end-of-round popup appears, Security arrests an antagonist who they had no prior suspicion of just because said popup lists them as an antagonist. - After the end-of-round popup appears, crew marooned on the station start killing people indiscriminately. - After the end-of-round popup appears, a non-antagonist passenger beats an engineer to death with a toolbox for having annoyed them earlier in the shift. - After the end-of-round popup appears, a silicon starts entirely ignoring their lawset.
